summary: Payhawk is spend management software for businesses across Europe, the US, and the UK, founded in 2018. Type: startup / scale-up. About 305 employees (Wikidata). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 4 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: London-headquartered, Bulgarian-founded spend management fintech expanding across Europe, with an entry-level Amsterdam sales job that needs no Dutch.

culture.text: Builds company cards, expense and accounts payable software for finance teams of scaling businesses.
Founded in 2018 and headquartered in London; had 305 employees in 2024.

open.text: Not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one open job here, an entry-level sales role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Opened offices in Stockholm and Warsaw as part of its European expansion.
CEO Hristo Borisov spoke about the company reaching 'centaur' status.

worth_knowing.text: Released an AI 'Financial Controller Agent' it says gathers vendor invoices 12 times faster than humans.
